# Self-hosted fonts

Upstream: google/fonts commit `9710da1eacb3be272583c3224dcb70f9da6eadbb`.
All families are SIL Open Font License 1.1. The original license files are kept alongside the fonts.
Variable TrueType sources are losslessly packaged as WOFF2 with fontTools; axes and glyphs are preserved.

- Archivo-Variable.woff2: wght 100–900, wdth 62–125; source [Archivo[wdth,wght].ttf](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/google/fonts/9710da1eacb3be272583c3224dcb70f9da6eadbb/ofl/archivo/Archivo%5Bwdth%2Cwght%5D.ttf); SHA256 `e9037163817939765279d4052b3b69158c07b1d0bfb98f8630ff603f54be5d30`.
- Geist-Variable.woff2: wght 100–900; source [Geist[wght].ttf](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/google/fonts/9710da1eacb3be272583c3224dcb70f9da6eadbb/ofl/geist/Geist%5Bwght%5D.ttf); SHA256 `2c5de11583773920c555d38353516c05cf28f12547d169bdbd391745ad8b241c`.
- GeistMono-Variable.woff2: wght 100–900; source [GeistMono[wght].ttf](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/google/fonts/9710da1eacb3be272583c3224dcb70f9da6eadbb/ofl/geistmono/GeistMono%5Bwght%5D.ttf); SHA256 `0f30473b15c71a6f7b98bbdaf7e6c601aaea04b66d6f82df874ac2ec14b9c66b`.
